description: Inventario de Alumbrado Público Yopal is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by E.S.P. de Alumbrado Público de Yopal, Casanare. Base de datos de luminarias de Yopal. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher E.S.P. de Alumbrado Público de Yopal, Casanare. Its tags are postes, luminarias, watios, potencia, led. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Minas y Energía. The portal shows 2022-09-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
